issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing check_status so it returns a Boolean (0 or 1) in EAX. The solution implementation of check_status places the address of the data label 'hello' into EAX (mov eax, hello) and returns that pointer value rather than a boolean 0/1. This contradicts the required return value semantics and would confuse students using the solution as a reference or when testing their implementation.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the solution's check_status to place a boolean value (0 or 1) into EAX before returning. For example, replace 'mov eax, hello' with an instruction that sets EAX to 0 or 1 as intended (e.g., 'mov eax, 1' or compute the correct condition then set eax to 0/1). Also update any comments to reflect that EAX holds a boolean, not an address.
